title: Robust Multi-Agent LLMs under Byzantine Faults
abstract: arXiv:2605.09076v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly collaborate over peer-to-peer networks to improve their reliability. However, these same interactions can also introduce vulnerability to unreliable or Byzantine agents that can propagate incorrect information and degrade overall system performance. To address this, we propose Self-Anchored Consensus (SAC), a fully decentralized filter-and-refine protocol in which agents iteratively exchange responses, locally evaluate and filter unreliable messages, and refine their own outputs. We present $(F{+}1)$-robustness conditions on the communication graph that ensure honest agents preserve and propagate reliable information despite Byzantine influence. Experiments across diverse open- and closed-weight LLMs on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks show that SAC effectively suppresses Byzantine influence and consistently improves performance across diverse communication topolog

translated_title: 拜占庭故障下鲁棒的多智能体大语言模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地通过对等网络进行协作以提高其可靠性。然而，这些交互也可能使系统容易受到不可靠或拜占庭智能体的影响，这些智能体会传播错误信息并降低整体系统性能。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了自锚定共识（Self-Anchored Consensus, SAC），这是一种完全去中心化的“过滤-精炼”协议，其中智能体迭代地交换响应，在本地评估并过滤不可靠的消息，并改进自己的输出。我们提出了通信图上的 $(F+1)$-鲁棒性条件，确保诚实智能体在拜占庭影响下仍能保留并传播可靠信息。在多种开源与闭源权重LLM上针对数学和常识推理基准的实验表明，SAC能有效抑制拜占庭影响，并在多种通信拓扑结构下持续提升性能。
tldr: 提出自锚定共识（SAC）协议，通过完全去中心化的过滤-精炼机制，使多智能体LLM系统能够在拜占庭故障下抑制错误信息传播并持续提升推理性能。
